# nlohmann/json

This directory vendors the single-header `nlohmann/json` 3.11.3 decoder for
the `wave-vortex-run` command-line request only. It is not linked into the
portable numerical library and introduces no runtime binary dependency.

- Source tag: `v3.11.3`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/nlohmann/json>
- `json.hpp` SHA-256: `9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6`
- `LICENSE.MIT` SHA-256: `62176251affdda17bece4ddd44271d68019e2448ca721d2c1af4c650f29c9898`

The upstream MIT notice is retained in `LICENSE.MIT`; its first-line trailing
space is normalized to satisfy repository whitespace policy.
